page_title: CHE 2-4 WOL | Chelsea v Wolves 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Tim Robinson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.

90+10' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Jose Sa has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90+8' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+8' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+6' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

90+4' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
90+1' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

90+1' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Joao Gomes is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Matt Doherty (Wolves).
88' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Chelsea as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
88' Referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Chelsea. Let’s see what happens!
87' That's the end of the game for Rayan Ait-Nouri, who is replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
86' 2 - 4 Gooal! Mykhailo Mudryk takes over corner duties. Thiago Silva (Chelsea) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom right corner. 2:4.
85' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
82' 1 - 4 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Djordje Petrovic into the bottom right corner.
81' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Ben Chilwell will be replaced by Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea).
81' The substitution has been made. Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) has replaced Malo Gusto.
81' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
80' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. Wolves are awarded a penalty kick!
78' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
78' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ben Chilwell (Chelsea). Tim Robinson saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
77' Some great controlled play and passing from Chelsea. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
75' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Gary O'Neil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Doyle (Wolves) replacing Pablo Sarabia.
72' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has come on for Pedro Neto.
72' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Christopher Nkunku is replaced by Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).
72' Substitution. Raheem Sterling leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
70' The ball is cleared after Pedro Neto (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
66' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) gets on the end of a cross from Matheus Cunha, but his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
63' 1 - 3 What a goal! Pedro Neto plays it to Matheus Cunha (Wolves), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Djordje Petrovic into the right side of the goal. 1:3.
63' Substitution. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) in, Moises Caicedo out.
61' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
60' The resulting corner from Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' A player from Wolves commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
59' The referee awards a corner and Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes over to take it.
58' Two players stand over the free kick. Pedro Neto (Wolves) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
56' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

56' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Wolves are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
56' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the shot whistles inches wide of the left post.
55' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Wolves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
52' The corner kick picks out Thiago Silva (Chelsea) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
52' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
51' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
51' Chance! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
49' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' Good chance! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

46' Pedro Neto (Wolves) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Djordje Petrovic thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 2 Axel Disasi (Chelsea) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
41' Pedro Neto (Wolves) has tested the patience of referee Tim Robinson and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Pedro Neto (Wolves) commits a foul during an attacking move.
41' Chance! Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
40' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
39' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Nelson Semedo (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
38' Joao Gomes (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Tim Robinson signals a foul.
35' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
34' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Chelsea, play can continue.

34' Play continues despite the shouts by some Chelsea players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tim Robinson interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
32' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Malo Gusto (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' A clumsy foul by Malo Gusto (Chelsea) and Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Wolves will take a free kick.
31' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
28' Toti (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' The free kick is delivered by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Joao Gomes plays it to Matheus Cunha (Wolves), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Djordje Petrovic. 1:1.

19' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Cole Palmer (Chelsea). Moises Caicedo plays a fantastic through ball and finds Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
17' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' Pedro Neto (Wolves) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
10' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Jose Sa has no trouble gathering it.
9' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
7' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
6' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
5' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Jose Sa displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

4' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
3' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
2' Decent spell from Chelsea here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
